items.briefing:
Online scams continue to be a growing concern for Australian staff, with reports highlighting how sophisticated and relentless scam operations have become. These often use fake blogs and websites to lure victims into handing over personal or financial information. Separately, OpenAI has launched a Computer History feature in ChatGPT for macOS, which records your computer activity to improve responses — staff should review their privacy settings before enabling this feature.

**Practical tip:** If ChatGPT prompts you to enable Computer History, check with your IT team first before turning it on, as it may capture sensitive work-related information.

featured.quote: Australia faces critical vulnerability crisis with patch backlogs leaving 85 high-impact flaws unpatched.
